steps.en: Officer selects a letter template to amend
steps.id: Officer memilih template letter untuk di-amend
steps.why_en: Letter templates cannot be selected; the screen lists only SMS and Email.
steps.why_id: Template letter tidak bisa dipilih; layar hanya menampilkan SMS dan Email.

steps.en: Officer edits the letter template text
steps.why_en: The edit form supports letters, but it cannot be opened from the screen and the Subject field is dropped.
steps.why_id: Form edit mendukung letter, tapi tidak bisa dibuka dari layar dan field Subject tidak disimpan.

steps.en: Officer uploads a QR code to embed in the letter
steps.id: Officer meng-upload QR code untuk di-embed di letter
steps.why_en: No QR upload or QR placement exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada upload QR maupun penempatan QR di code.

steps.en: Officer generates a sample PDF of the amended letter
steps.id: Officer meng-generate PDF contoh letter yang di-amend
steps.why_en: Only the batch letter run builds PDFs; there is no sample PDF for the officer.
steps.why_id: PDF hanya dibuat oleh batch letter; tidak ada PDF contoh untuk officer.

steps.en: Officer downloads the revised PDF to review
steps.id: Officer mengunduh PDF revisi untuk di-review
steps.why_en: No download exists; the screen has only Back and Update actions.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada unduhan; layar hanya punya aksi Back dan Update.
